about: Eason Technology Limited, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the real estate operation management and investment business in the People's Republic of China. The company offers management consulting services to property owners and businesses; and entrusted management services, including lease management, maintenance, and oversight of renovation projects. It also provides digital security solutions to enterprises to protect critical data and information assets; and digital security hardware products designed to safeguard personal user privacy and data security. The company was formerly known as Dunxin Financial Holdings Limited and changed its name to Eason Technology Limited in January 2025. Eason Technology Limited is based in Kowloon, Hong Kong.
